scope: Only explicitly authorized parsed DXF AC1027 exact eight-byte cache 0800000000000000, exact built-in LIGHT, same target revision and codepage, with one-shot exact writer/entity permit. The caller must revoke and re-authorize after any cache or geometry edit; this is not automatic mutation detection or source-geometry binding. Low-level writer transport only; strict dx_iface output policy is unchanged.
source_lineage: Locally authored LIGHT color witness from tools/author_light_dxf_421.py, ODA File Converter 27.1.0 DXF to ACAD2013 DWG to DXF, as recorded in p6-light-dxf-421-true-color-2026-11-04.json. A hash-bound exact LIGHT record is projected into a minimal HEADER/ENTITIES DXF. Its object graph is not retained.
procedure: Compile tools/probe_light_dxf_preview.cpp against candidate libdxfrw.a, then invoke with selected-source.dxf and selected-ascii.dxf ascii, and selected-source.dxf and selected-binary.dxf binary.

Convert those two DXFs to ACAD2013 DWG and the resulting DWGs back to ACAD2013 DXF with ODA File Converter 27.1.0. Both conversions returned output without .err. The input/output lineage is the recorded local converter run, not independently established by hashes.
observations: ezdxf 1.4.5 verifies exact selected original/source LIGHT tag record, and count, preview bytes, ACI, RGB, name, point and intensity in both emitted and ODA-returned DXFs. Generated test covers ASCII/Binary, parsed Binary provenance, byte/count/revision/type/caller-origin refusal, destination preservation, same-writer retry, and same-writer resolver reentry. Resolver controls additionally reject authorization, byte mutation, revocation and removal after initial preflight, preserving the destination and permitting same-writer retry. After this hardening, regenerated ASCII and Binary physical selected outputs are byte-identical to the ODA-converted inputs. Same-writer resolver reentry with the same LIGHT, a different authorized LIGHT with fresh source handle, and a fresh LINE all fail atomically; independent nested writers remain usable, including A-to-B-to-A refusal and exception-unwind/retry. The resolver guard is active only for approved preview transport. Physical selected outputs remain byte-identical to the recorded ODA inputs.
limits: No automatic LIGHT adapter authorization or complete-scene output. LIGHTLIST graph closure and sparse MATERIAL raw graph remain open.

Exact bytes have no independently established header semantics; ODA spec v5.4.1 section 29 describes generic proxy chunks and does not establish meaning of this 8-byte header. Source is an ODA producer observation; ODA conversion does not prove native application rendering, freshness or complete proxy-resource semantics.
Changing caller geometry with unchanged bytes remains caller responsibility; the runtime checks only captured DXF provenance, revision/codepage, explicit consent, exact type and bytes.
The selected DXF is a minimal projection; ODA return does not qualify source dictionary/ownership, complete source fidelity or automatic replay.
No public object layout, vtable, or new virtual changes; standalone low-level callers must explicitly opt in.
integrated_validation: The integrated explicit LIGHT preview, existing LIGHT adapter and DXF true-color controls passed, including resolver reentry, post-preflight mutation and retry.
